params.1274: Get a staff. (Defeating Caitlin in The Blood Pact will cause her to drop a staff for you).
params.1275: Click on your inventory to open that sidebar, then click on the staff to wield it.
params.1276: You can see your equipped staff in the equipment screen, and remove it if you wish by clicking on it again.
params.2225: Some staves provide an infinite supply of a rune needed to cast certain spells, eg the air staff gives you unlimited air runes.
